about.title: KoreManager
about.desc: KoreManager was born as a Final Degree Project with a clear goal: to digitalise the booking of municipal sports facilities. Goodbye to queues, paperwork and phone calls. Hello to efficiency, transparency and sport without barriers.
about.testimonial: "I used to take 15 minutes to book a court by phone. With KoreManager I do it in 30 seconds from my mobile. It's a before and after."

how.title: Three steps and you're on court

s1.title: Pick a sport and court
s1.desc: Filter by padel, futsal or tennis and see which courts are free.

s2.title: Choose your time
s2.desc: The calendar updates in real time: if it shows as free, it is free.

s3.title: Pay and play
s3.desc: Secure card payment and instant confirmation. All that's left is warming up.
